q32_decay_assertion: For h>=1100, A lambda^(h-1) <= lambda^(h/2) = exp(-2 delta h), delta=-log(lambda)/4. Checked by exact squaring A^2 lambda^(1098)<1; larger h only improves it.
h_equals_zero_boundary: The manuscript correctly restricts both word-mass conclusions to h>=1. A separately defined empty-word mass is 1; its claimed lower prefactor would not extend to h=0.
